title: Dictionary defaults and grouping
summary: Count repeated words with a default subscript and group words by character count.
triggers: count occurrences or partition values by a derived key
prompts: Build word frequencies and length groups for a vocabulary list.
invariant: Each encountered word increments one count and belongs to one length group.
mantra: Default missing counts; group by the derived key.
pitfalls: Dictionary iteration order is not a display ordering guarantee.
Dictionary(grouping:) retains duplicates within each group.
